description: Original johnson tests.rs with bounded correspondence models.
state: Finite native test inputs, literal fixtures and oracle outcomes for johnson; trusted Rust harness. Ordered directed adjacency lists with i64 weights; at most 1024 vertices and one million edges. Returned observation is the complete Result of an i128 optional distance matrix.
cost: Finite enumeration cost includes independent oracle; no production timing or unbounded correctness inferred.
forward: Execute bounded fixtures and independent oracles, assert exact outputs and return harness pass/failure identities. 4 tests: exhaustive ternary absent/-1/+2 directed graphs including loops on 0..3 vertices (19768 graphs); disconnected cycle, global-invalid precedence, vertex/edge limits, wide i128 reweighting, potential shifts and redundant arcs. Independent Floyd-Warshall supplies minimum-distance and global cycle oracle.
inverse: Let U be declared inputs crossed with returned observations and R the forward relation in model.md#approximant. C=U minus R includes wrong first errors, wrong values and forbidden results. This is an exact specification complement and partial source-derived model, not a measured global Rust complement. For this test file, false acceptance of a mismatching finite fixture is excluded by assertions; passing unseen implementations remains possible.

Pre(y)={x in domain | R(x,y)} retains all compatible inputs. A passing harness observation has many compatible implementations agreeing on tested cases; failure identities retain every implementation/oracle pair producing that failure. No unique recovery or inverse executor is claimed.
limitations: Finite evidence is not a general proof; allocation failures unmodeled.
